Background images for long-form. source='banana_generated' = AI-generated by Agent 2.2 (image_copyright_gate path A). source='owner_provided_unverified' = owner-supplied images of unknown/unverified provenance, explicitly risk-accepted by the channel owner on 2026-07-27 (image_copyright_gate path B) — see config/gates.json long_form_gates.image_copyright_gate.rationale_path_b. Folder 1eDQ9-NyZ1ko8WTmaNSDtrNwQUFuQI24g (used for lf_002-lf_008) is now LEGACY — do not assign new candidates to it going forward.

ACTIVE SOURCE as of 2026-07-28 (owner direction): Drive folder `1ZdzOguJXaP4zxDSPVpuOTXhWGfTBOy09`, 20 PNG images, source='owner_ai_generated_from_reference'. Owner's own explanation of provenance: found real photos online, had ChatGPT turn each into a structured JSON scene description, then generated new images from that JSON prompt (text-to-image synthesis, not direct reuse/edit of the original photo). This is meaningfully lower copyright risk than owner_provided_unverified (no reused pixels from an unknown rights-holder's photo), closer in kind to banana_generated — but flag one residual thing when a candidate actually gets inspected: if the JSON prompt was detailed enough to reproduce very specific real elements (e.g. a legible real-format license plate, a specific yacht's name, exact real signage), the output could still read as a close derivative of a particular real photo's protectable composition, not just a generic 'AI luxury scene'. Two samples spot-checked before adoption (files 1HQFlCeapYGRb4yC1Etx_gwEKF3h-wJ7Z, 1VDAa_hxA36MagxyUG0Zv4w8ZBCaLpCzK) came back at 1672x941 — much higher resolution than the legacy folder's ~736x414 stills, and one showed legible Dubai-format license plates ('V 463', 'V 91191', 'J') and a readable yacht name ('Ushi') worth being aware of if a future viewer/rightsholder ever raises a concern, though these read as AI-synthesized text rather than a literal copy. Agent 2.2 must still individually inspect+vet each file before use per the normal Path B discipline (watermarks, ad/scam text, off-theme content) and record source='owner_ai_generated_from_reference' with this note referenced.

images.provenance_note: Generic filename does not indicate scam/ad content directly (unlike the sibling file in the same folder titled with a Russian Bitcoin-wallet ad), but is a low-resolution (736x412 source) web-sourced image of unknown rights-holder. Used per owner's explicit instruction: 'just try to make one video, if it gets copyrighted ill change the plan'.

Downloaded and inspected by Agent 2.2 on this cycle: actual content is NOT a car/mansion scene as the prior placeholder note assumed — it is a Dubai Marina night skyline shot (736x414 source), high-rise towers, illuminated blue-lit waterfront promenade, and moored yachts/boats in the marina channel. No scam/ad text, no stock-photo watermark (checked top/bottom edge crops at 3x zoom, both clean). One real observation: several towers carry legible 'EMAAR' illuminated signage (Emaar Properties, a real Dubai developer) — this is naturally-occurring architectural signage baked into the original photograph (comparable to any real skyline photo showing building names), not a deliberately placed logo/watermark/ad overlay like the excluded Bitcoin-wallet file. Judged not to rise to the 'obvious active red flag' bar that would warrant skipping under Path B guidance, but disclosed here for the record per the same scrutiny applied to lf_002. visual_theme in long_form_queue.json corrected to match actual content. Also reused (distinct crop/mood/treatment) for lf_008 — see that candidate's brief in state/long_form_queue.json for why the same file is assigned twice.

Downloaded and inspected by Agent 2.2 this cycle: actual content is NOT a car/mansion driveway scene as the prior placeholder note assumed — it is a Dubai Marina night skyline shot (736x414 source) from a lower, closer angle than lf_003's, with a row of moored white motor yachts filling the left/center foreground on dark reflective water and warm-lit high-rise towers behind. No scam/ad text, no stock-photo watermark (checked top/bottom edge crops at 2x zoom, both clean). Same 'EMAAR' illuminated architectural signage present on background towers as lf_003 — naturally-occurring, not a deliberate logo/watermark overlay; disclosed here for the record per the same scrutiny applied to lf_002/lf_003. visual_theme in long_form_queue.json corrected to match actual content.

Downloaded and inspected by Agent 2.2 this cycle: 735x490 JPEG, 44638 bytes (matches Drive metadata exactly). Confirms the folder-level guess this time -- unlike lf_003/lf_004 (which turned out to be Dubai Marina skylines despite the same folder-theme guess), this file genuinely is a car/mansion night scene: a modern minimalist dark-wood/concrete garage bay at night with two supercars parked inside (a black Lamborghini Huracan-style car on the left, a bronze/champagne Porsche 911 GT-style car on the right), warm interior downlighting, exterior wall sconces, dark evergreen trees at the left edge, wet-look concrete driveway in the foreground. No visible license plates, logos, faces, or watermark/ad text -- top/bottom/left/right edge crops at 3x zoom checked and clean, same scrutiny applied as lf_004's inspection.

Downloaded and inspected by Agent 2.2 this cycle: 735x490 JPEG, 58778 bytes (matches Drive metadata exactly). Confirms the folder-level guess -- genuinely is a car/mansion night scene: a paved stone courtyard/driveway at night with two dark supercars (a black Lamborghini-style car on the left with its scissor door raised and illuminated rear diffuser/wing, and a dark sports car on the right with a red LED taillight strip, likely Porsche-style) parked facing each other, a white garage door with wall sconce lighting at left, ivy/foliage draping the wall above, a large palm/tropical leaf frond in the right foreground, and a third car (silver sedan) plus additional exterior lights visible in the blurred background. No visible license plates, faces, watermark/ad text, or 'download link' overlay -- edge crops checked at 3x zoom (all four borders), all clean. Same scrutiny applied as lf_002-lf_005.
